title: Thus Spoke Poet Kalidasa
subtitle: A Poet’s Secret in the Shadows
summary: When Byomkesh Bakshi and his companion are welcomed into an enigmatic household, they quickly sense that beneath the surface of hospitality lies a mystery waiting to be unraveled. With a cast of intriguing characters and subtle clues, the stage is set for a case where poetic riddles may hold the key to the truth. Follow Byomkesh as he navigates wit and deception to expose secrets hidden in plain sight.
